definition: One of the three federal economic immigration programmes managed through Express Entry, for people with qualifying skilled work experience gained inside Canada — including former international students and temporary foreign workers.
longform: Because it rewards Canadian work experience specifically, it is the programme that most directly connects a period of study or employer-sponsored work in Canada to a later Express Entry application. Verify before publish — confirm the current minimum experience and language requirements before stating them.
